title: Aah Ya Hussain
body:
Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Bayaan Karta Hu Mai Waqt e Asr Ka Manzar
Tha Ek Khushk Gala Aur Shimr Ka Khanjar
Mayaane Khanjar o Sir Thi Hussain Ki Madar
Jo De Rahi Thi Sada Bekhata Hai Mera Pisar
Kaha Ye Narm Gala - 2 Aur Kaha Ye Kund Churi
Hai Teen Roz Ka Pyaasa Hussain Ibn Ali
Ya Hussain - 6
Ek Sayyed Ko Pardesi Ko Mehmaan Banakar Lut Liya
<<MINI>>
Dasht Me Gunj Utha Zehra Ka Nauha
<<DIVIDER>>
Aah Ya Hussain
Na Maro Na Maro Na Maro - 2
